lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Hello, Venkatesh Murthy avara number alva? Kaveri Finance inda.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ಅವರು ಸ್ನಾನಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗಿದ್ದಾರೆ, ನಾನು ಅವರ wife. ಏನು ವಿಷಯ?
lines.roman: Avaru snaanakke hogiddaare, naanu avara wife. Enu vishaya?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Madam, nimma yajamanru bike loan mooru EMI kattilla, eleven thousand seven hundred rupees baaki ide. Avarige heli bega kattoke, illandre bike seize maadthivi.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ಅಯ್ಯೋ, ನನಗೆ ಗೊತ್ತೇ ಇರಲಿಲ್ಲ... ಇರಿ, ಕೊಡ್ತೀನಿ.
lines.roman: Ayyo, nanage gotthe iralilla... Iri, kodthini.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Hello, ನಾನು Venkatesh. ನನ್ನ wife ಹತ್ರ ಯಾಕೆ loan ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಹೇಳಿದ್ರಿ?
lines.roman: Hello, naanu Venkatesh. Nanna wife hathra yaake loan bagge helidri?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Neevu phone ethalla, adakke helde. Mooru thingalinda yaake EMI kattilla?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ನನ್ನ ಅಪ್ಪನಿಗೆ heart operation ಆಯ್ತು sir, ಎಲ್ಲಾ ದುಡ್ಡು ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಹೋಯ್ತು.
lines.roman: Nanna appanige heart operation aaythu sir, ellaa duddu alli hoythu.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Ella customers ide kathe heltheera. Eega eshtu kattheera adanna heli.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ಈಗ ಏನೂ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಮುಂದಿನ ತಿಂಗಳು ನೋಡ್ತೀನಿ.
lines.roman: Eega enoo illa. Mundina thingalu nodthini.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Mundina thingalu alla. Ee vaara kattilla andre bike seize maadi, nimma office ge kooda bandu maathadthivi.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ಹೀಗೆ ಹೆದರಿಸ್ಬೇಡಿ. ನಾನು ಏನೂ commit ಮಾಡಲ್ಲ, complaint ಕೊಡ್ತೀನಿ.
lines.roman: Heege hedarisbedi. Naanu enoo commit maadalla, complaint kodthini.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Give complaint, no problem. Your CIBIL is already spoiled, nobody will give you a loan now.

analysis.outcomeRationale: Customer refused to commit to any payment and said he would file a complaint after repeated threats.
analysis.summary: Agent disclosed the three missed EMIs (₹11,700) to the borrower's wife before reaching the borrower, then threatened vehicle seizure and an office visit. Borrower, who cited his father's heart surgery, refused to commit and threatened a complaint.
analysis.observations: Multiple RBI fair-practice breaches: loan details and a seizure threat given to a family member without verification, disbelief of a medical hardship ('Ella customers ide kathe heltheera'), threat of a workplace visit, and a demeaning CIBIL remark. High complaint and regulatory risk on a recoverable medical-hardship case.
analysis.improvements: Escalate for compliance review. Never discuss dues with relatives — ask for a callback time instead. Acknowledge medical hardship, explore partial payment or a revised date, and explain bureau reporting factually rather than as a threat.

op_greet_company.rationale: Said 'Hello' and named Kaveri Finance, without a proper greeting.

op_rpc_verify.rationale: Discussed the loan with the person who answered without confirming she was the borrower.

ds_reason_delay.rationale: Asked why the EMIs were not paid for three months.

ds_empathy.rationale: Dismissed the father's heart operation as a story every customer tells.

ds_ability_to_pay.rationale: Asked how much he could pay now, though brusquely.

ng_state_dues.rationale: Stated three missed EMIs and ₹11,700 total — but to the wife, not the borrower.

ng_consequences.rationale: Consequences framed as seizure threats and a demeaning CIBIL remark, not factual explanation.

ng_options.rationale: Rejected next month without offering any partial payment or revised date.

cp_no_threats.rationale: Threatened bike seizure and a visit to the borrower's office.

cp_respectful.rationale: Mocked the customer's credit standing and disbelieved his hardship.

cp_no_third_party.rationale: Disclosed missed EMIs, amount and seizure threat to the borrower's wife.

cl_ptp_secured.rationale: No promise-to-pay; customer refused to commit.

cl_recap.rationale: Ended with 'field team barthaare' instead of a recap.
